hypothesis.statement: THE COUNT PARITY IS A COUPLED PAIR, AND THAT IS WHY EVERY SINGLE-SIDED PROBE READ AS A LOSS. The 59/59 parity is not one residual, it is two opposite one-instruction errors that cancel. (i) THE LOAD FORM: retail spends TWO words reading lbl_80344610 (`li r3,0 @lbl_80344610(EMB_SDA21)` at +0x40 then `lwz r3,0(r3)` at +0x48); we spend ONE (`lwz r0,0(0) @lbl_80344610(EMB_SDA21)` at +0x40). We are -1 here. (ii) THE idx REMATERIALISATION: retail materialises `li r6,0` exactly ONCE, at +0x18, and keeps r6 live all the way through the else-arm sprintf at +0x88 (nothing on that path writes r6; the then-arm's `lbz r6` at +0x54 is on the other path). We materialise it TWICE, at +0x18 AND again at +0x84. We are +1 here. -1 and +1 sum to zero, which is exactly the 59/59 parity. UB's probe B is the correct cure for (i) and measured +1 ALONE for precisely this reason; it was never paired with a cure for (ii). The untried closing pair is probe B plus any form that stops the second `li r6,0` -- NOT UB's 'probe B plus a form that removes the surviving mr', which UC already refuted.
